verify.note: Both modes replayed on every recording: at every hook every register with R and all 48K RAM against the original; at every publication Layer 2 against a picture built independently (default: the figures' ink in plot order; Enhanced: the map and plots, with the game's back buffer against the same model in mono); ABI cases (four clocks, both IFF values, eight R phases) on the sites reached; 9 broken builds a mode on s2. Rooms 13, 16, 22, 34 and level complete were replayed from test copies in the review run (games/ruff_and_reddy.md "Evidence"), not here.
